## About

SDRC (Secunderabad Diagnostic and Research Centre) is a NABL accredited multi-specialty diagnostic centre established in 1983, located at 101, Jade Arcade (Corporate Block), Paradise, MG Road, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, Telangana, India — PIN 500003.

NABL accreditation: ISO 15189:2022 | Certificate no: MC-7820 | Lab code: M-5930

## Contact

WhatsApp: Available via website

Sunday and public holidays: 7:00 AM – 2:00 PM

- Yapral, Secunderabad — Ambey Nilayam, Ground Floor, Bhanu Enclave

## Services

### Imaging
- Ultra-Fast Multi-Slice CT (head, chest, abdomen and more)
- Digital X-Ray
- Digital Mammography
- DEXA (Dual-energy X-ray Absorptiometry) — body composition and bone density
- Ultrasound and Colour Doppler (abdominal, obstetric, pelvic, thyroid, breast, vascular)

### Cardio-Pulmonary and Neurology
- ECG (electrocardiogram)
- 2D-Echo (echocardiogram)
- TMT (Treadmill Stress Test)
- Spirometry / PFT (Pulmonary Function Test)
- EEG (electroencephalogram)
- ENMG (electroneuromyography)

### Pathology Laboratory (NABL accredited for select parameters)
- Biochemistry: liver, kidney, lipid, glucose and metabolic profiles
- Endocrinology: thyroid, cortisol, reproductive hormones
- Haematology: CBC, ESR, coagulation
- Clinical Pathology: urine, stool, body fluid
- Microbiology and Serology: cultures, sensitivity, rapid tests
- Cytopathology and Histopathology: FNAC, tissue biopsy

## DEXA Scan — Key Facts

DEXA (Dual-energy X-ray Absorptiometry) at SDRC uses a GE Lunar DPX-NT Densitometer (ID 152585).

Two scan types are offered:

1. Total Body DEXA — primary purpose is body composition. Measures body fat %, lean mass, resting metabolic rate, android/gynoid fat distribution and total body bone mineral density overview. Produces a 5-page clinical report.

2. Dedicated Spine + Hip DEXA — primary purpose is bone mineral density (BMD). Measures L1–L4 lumbar spine BMD and femoral neck BMD. Used for WHO osteoporosis classification (T-score, Z-score).

DEXA is recommended for:
- People on GLP-1 medications (semaglutide / Ozempic, Wegovy; tirzepatide / Mounjaro) to monitor fat vs. muscle loss and bone density changes
- Post-menopausal women for osteoporosis screening
- Men over 50
- Athletes tracking body composition
- People with diabetes, PCOD, thyroid conditions or metabolic disorders
- Long-term corticosteroid users

Radiation dose: less than 1 microsievert — equivalent to approximately 30 minutes of background radiation. No fasting required.

## Health Check Packages

SDRC offers Master Health Check packages covering basic, cardiac, diabetic, women's wellness and lifestyle panels. Packages include pathology tests, imaging components and physician-friendly reports. Comparison and online booking available at https://sdrc.in/packages.

## Report Access

Reports are available via print, email, WhatsApp and the SDRC online portal. WhatsApp-based report retrieval is available using a registered mobile number.

## Home Sample Collection

Home sample collection is available for select blood and urine tests. Book via the SDRC website or WhatsApp.
